coverage_note: The current database contains Scolytinae records only. Platypodinae is part of the long-term project scope but has not yet been integrated into the database.
geographic_scope: China checklist, including separately tracked Mainland China, Taiwan, Hong Kong, and Macao occurrence assessments where available.
profile_count_status: 576 source-supported China Scolytinae taxon profiles through VSN_6555. VSN_6154 (Xyleborus aquilus Blandford, 1894) and VSN_6345 (Xyleborus rufobrunneus Eggers, 1929) are retained in the Notion taxonomic backbone but excluded from the public China checklist following source-based identity review. VSN_4713 remains excluded.
